scripts.lint: biome lint . && npm run architecture:check && npm run unused:check
scripts.check: npm run biome:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.test:deployment: npm run test:installer && node --test deployment/qbittorrent-init.test.mjs deployment/jackett-init.test.mjs
scripts.test: npm run architecture:test && npm run test:deployment && npm run test --workspace @anishelf/client-core && npm run test --workspace @anishelf/backend && npm run test --workspace @anishelf/client-ui
scripts.start: npm run build --workspace @anishelf/backend && npm run start:backend
scripts.dev:desktop:all: concurrently --kill-others --success first --names backend,desktop "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:desktop"
scripts.dev: ANISHELF_LOG_LEVEL=debug concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:host: ANISHELF_LOG_LEVEL=debug concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev --workspace @anishelf/web -- --host 0.0.0.0"
